headline.purpose: Local RobotoCondensedBold font, assets/fonts/RobotoCondensed-Bold.ttf; also used by masthead and scores. Instantiated at weight 700 with fontTools from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/robotocondensed. License: assets/fonts/OFL.txt.

components.name: Refresh
components.description: HTML translation of native control; browser default focus retained.
components.html: <button class="ds-refresh"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#686e68" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 7v5h-5M4 17v-5h5M5.5 8a7 7 0 0 1 11.55-2.65L20 8M4 16l2.95 2.65A7 7 0 0 0 18.5 16"/></svg>Обновить</button>
components.css: .ds-refresh { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:#222622; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-refresh:hover,.ds-refresh:active { background:#f3f4f1; } .ds-refresh:disabled { opacity:.6; }

components.name: Retry
components.description: Recovery action; source defines no custom hover or focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-retry { min-height:44px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid #e3e6df; border-radius:8px; background:#f3f4f1; color:#bd342a; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Club search
components.description: Wide-layout search translation; compact native layout expands its wrapper to full width.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-box"><svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#686e68" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4.5 4.5"/></svg><input class="ds-search" aria-label="Поиск по названию клуба" placeholder="Найти клуб"></label>
components.css: .ds-search-box { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-width:160px; max-width:230px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:4px; background:#f3f4f1; } .ds-search { width:100%; min-width:0; min-height:44px; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; color:#222622; font-size:13px; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-search::placeholder { color:#686e68; }

components.name: Selected filter
components.description: Red text and underline identify selection; native browser focus retained in this translation.
components.css: .ds-tab { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; min-width:44px; min-height:54px; padding:0; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid #bd342a; background:transparent; color:#bd342a; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-tab:hover,.ds-tab:active { background:#f3f4f1; } .ds-count { font-size:12px; font-weight:400; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Selected favorite
components.description: Filled native SVG star; HTML target matches the visible 44px control but does not reproduce native hitSlop.
components.html: <button class="ds-favorite" aria-label="Убрать из избранного" aria-pressed="true"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 3 2.78 5.64L21 9.55l-4.5 4.39 1.06 6.2L12 17.21l-5.56 2.93 1.06-6.2L3 9.55l6.22-.91L12 3Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-favorite { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-width:44px; min-height:44px; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:#bd342a; } .ds-favorite:hover,.ds-favorite:active { background:#f3f4f1; }

components.css: .ds-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:20px; min-height:105px; padding:22px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid #e3e6df; background:#fff5f2; color:#222622; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-meta { width:160px; flex-shrink:0; color:#686e68; font-size:12px; line-height:18px; } .ds-status { color:#bd342a; font-weight:600; } .ds-teams { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:22px; flex:1; min-width:0; } .ds-club { flex:1; min-width:0; font-size:17px; line-height:23px; font-weight:600; } .ds-home { text-align:right; } .ds-city { margin-top:4px; color:#686e68; font-size:12px; line-height:17px; font-weight:400; } .ds-score { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:78px; min-height:44px; flex-shrink:0; border-radius:4px; background:#bd342a; color:#fff; font-family:RobotoCondensedBold,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif; font-size:28px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } @media(max-width:759px) { .ds-row { flex-direction:column; align-items:stretch; gap:18px; padding:18px 14px 22px; } .ds-meta { width:100%; } .ds-teams { gap:12px; } .ds-club { font-size:15px; line-height:21px; } }

narrative.overview: The implemented screen uses a compact football results list: a condensed masthead, prominent scores, flat rows and restrained red states. It replaces the earlier rounded card grid following the user's request to make the interface feel less AI-generated.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous match list with fine dividers.
White background and muted olive-gray supporting tones.
Condensed headings and scores; platform sans for clubs and controls.
dos: Do keep match rows in one continuous list across widths.
Do reuse the existing color roles, local display font and SVG icon style.
Do preserve wrapping, device-local time labels and accessible control states.
donts: Don't restore the previous two-column rounded-card layout.
Don't encode status or favorite selection through color alone.
Don't present untested native rendering or custom focus/animation effects as verified behavior.
